# Which Cricut Heat Press Is Right for You?


-
-
-


20 October 2026


[Cricut](https://cricut.com/blog/author/cricut/)


If you’re wondering which Cricut heat press is best for your making needs, you’ve come to the right place.


---


Choosing a heat press doesn’t need to be complicated. Start by considering a few basic questions: do you want a compact press for small designs or a handheld press for T-shirts? Will you be making a few pieces at a time or working in large batches? Do you have a dedicated workspace, or are portability and storage more important?


The good news is there’s a Cricut heat press for almost every type of maker and project. Our heat presses range from compact presses designed for small and detailed applications to larger, automatic heat press machines built for bigger designs and repeat production.


The right heat press for you comes down to what you make, how large your designs are, how frequently you press, and how much hands-on control you want.

### Quick answer


Because each Cricut heat press is designed to support specific types of projects, it’s easier to determine the kinds of projects you want to make before you choose a heat press.


- **Cricut EasyPress Mini™** is for small to medium designs and blanks, like shoes, hats, baby bodysuits, and other tiny pieces or curved areas. It works perfectly around zippers, seams, and hard-to-reach places.
- **Cricut EasyPress SE®** is a great choice for everyday T-shirts, totes, and general heat-transfer projects, and is available in 9 in x 9 in and 12 in x 10 in sizes.
- **Cricut AutoPress 2® – 12 x 12** is an automatic heat press that streamlines the making process for blanks like standard T-shirts and totes, and delivers 110-lbs of consistent pressure.
- **Cricut AutoPress® 2 – 15 x 15** is an automatic heat press that accommodates larger designs, oversized, thicker apparel like sweatshirts. It includes a larger pressing area and adjustable pressure up to 220 lbs that can be optimized for a small business or repeatable batch making.
- **Cricut Mug Press™** customizes compatible mugs using Infusible Ink® and sublimation materials.


## How to choose your Cricut heat press


The best Cricut heat press for you comes down to determining what you want to make and how often. Are you casually making T-shirts, the occasional tote bag, themed pillow covers, or holiday decor? Do you want to work in batches, regularly making multiples of the same design, maybe as a small business?


Something else to consider: do you have a dedicated space for a heat press? Or do you need something you can easily store?


Answering these crucial questions will help guide you to the right Cricut heat press.


## For compact heat presses, should you choose Cricut EasyPress Mini™ – 3 x 2 or the new Cricut EasyPress Mini™ – 6 x 3?


When you’re looking at our mini heat presses, the size of the heat plate matters because the smaller the plate, the smaller the area you can cover with each pass.


[Cricut EasyPress Mini – 3 x 2](https://cricut.com/en-us/cricut-heat-presses/cricut-easypress-mini-zen-blue/2011869.html) is well suited for small heat transfer applications where precision and maneuverability matter most.


The larger heat plate of[Cricut EasyPress Mini – 6 x 3](https://cricut.com/en-us/heat-presses/cricut-easypress-mini/easypress-mini-6-x-3/cricut-easypress-mini---6-x-3-powder-blue/2013493.html) gives you more surface area to work with while maintaining the compact format and precision tip of a mini heat press.


One thing to note about working with a mini heat press: you may need to move across a design a few times rather than covering your design in one application like a larger heat press allows you to do. The teardrop-shaped plate means you can see the results as you go, ensuring quality adhesion so your project turns out just right. Choose a mini heat press for projects that are small, detailed, or curved.


### Cricut EasyPress Mini™ LT vs EasyPress Mini™ – 3×2


Choosing between[EasyPress Mini LT](https://cricut.com/en-us/cricut-heat-presses/cricut-easypress-mini-lt-blue/2012589.html) and EasyPress Mini™ – 3×2 comes down to your primary crafting style:


- Choose the **EasyPress Mini™ LT** if you are primarily interested in simple, smaller, or detailed projects using iron-on materials. It’s a compact, quick, and precise solution perfect for little details where you value simplicity and speed.
- Choose the **EasyPress Mini** ™ **– 3×2** if you want the same precision for small or tricky projects, but need the added flexibility to work on a wider range of materials that require varying heat settings, including Infusible Ink®, sublimation, and more.


Both the EasyPress Mini and the EasyPress Mini LT work for more challenging surfaces, designed with tip and edge control in mind. Their pointed tips and small heat plate area allow you to move with contours of the surface, get between the buttons, and squeeze into seams.


## Cricut EasyPress® SE heat presses: Portable coverage in 9 in x 9 in and 12 in x 10 in dimensions


Cricut EasyPress SE heat presses are a great choice for working with common materials like


iron-on (HTV), Infusible Ink®, and sublimation products.


Choose[Cricut EasyPress SE – 9 x 9](https://cricut.com/en-us/heat-presses/cricut-easypress/easypress-9x9/cricut-easypress-se---9-in-x-9-in-taupe/2012727.html) if:


- You want to press standard T-shirts and tote bags
- You’re looking for a more compact heat press
- Most of your designs fit within the 9 in x 9 in heat plate


Choose[Cricut EasyPress SE – 12 x 10](https://cricut.com/en-us/heat-presses/cricut-easypress/easypress-12x10/cricut-easypress-se-%E2%80%93-12-in-x-10-in-slate-blue/2012729.html) if:


- You regularly work with larger designs
- You want to press bigger T-shirts and blanks
- You need a larger heat plate that’s more compact than an automatic heat press


## Cricut AutoPress™ 2: Hands-free pressing in 12 in x 12 in and 15 in x 15 in sizes


Ready to upgrade to a bigger heat press? For makers looking for a fast, hands-free approach to heat pressing, both[Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12](https://cricut.com/en-us/heat-presses/cricut-autopress/cricut-autopress-2---12-x-12/cricut-autopress-2---12-x-12-powder-blue/2013279.html) and[Cricut AutoPress 2 – 15 x 15](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H4H8YNY2?maas=maas_adg_33B57FB577B7798070F5E4B070BEF6BE_afap_abs&ref_=aa_maas&tag=maas) are great choices.


Both models are automatic heat presses with Zero Effort™ hands-free automatic pressing and include features like adjustable time and temperature settings, edge-to-edge even heat, and 4 programmable presets to speed up the making process.


Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 has a 12 in x 12 in heat plate that accommodates blanks like standard T-shirts, tote bags, pillowcases, and delivers consistent 110-lb pressure.


If you regularly work with oversized designs or larger blanks like XL T-shirts, bigger sweatshirts, and blankets, Cricut AutoPress 2 – 15 x 15 has a larger 15 in x 15 in heat plate, adjustable pressure settings up to 220 lbs, and automatically adjusts to accommodate thicker materials.


Both Cricut AutoPress 2 models also allow you to work with specialty materials like Puff Iron-On and DTF Transfers using programmable presets.


## Cricut EasyPress vs. Cricut AutoPress 2: Manual control or automatic pressure?


The biggest difference between Cricut EasyPress and Cricut AutoPress 2 heat presses is not just size – it’s the way you work.


Cricut EasyPress SE is a portable, handheld heat press. You place your design on the blank, position the heat press over your design, set the temperature and time, apply manual pressure, and control the entire pressing process yourself. This makes it convenient for everyday projects and makers who want something that’s easy to store and move.


Both Cricut AutoPress 2 models are tabletop heat presses that automate the pressing process and apply consistent pressure. The larger pressing area and automated workflow make Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 and Cricut AutoPress 2 – 15 x 15 particularly useful for larger projects, frequent use, and batch making.


## Cricut Mug Press™ for compatible mugs


You can make pro-looking mugs in minutes with the[Cricut Mug Press](https://cricut.com/en-us/heat-presses/cricut-mug-press?utm_campaign=research&utm_medium=blogpost&utm_source=cricut_blog&utm_content=mug-press&utm_term=) . Custom mugs are a great way to create everything from group gifts, last-minute host presents, holiday-themed mugs, and more.


It’s easy to make your own designs and custom looks with[Design Space®](https://design.cricut.com/) , but if you need some inspiration, check out these[5 DIY mug design ideas](https://cricut.com/blog?p=39791) or search Design Space for more ready-to-make projects.


## Choose by material: Iron-On (HTV), Infusible Ink®, sublimation, DTF Transfers, and Puff Iron-On


Are there certain materials you love to work with? Narrowing down the type of material you want to make with can help you figure out which Cricut heat press is right for you. Cricut materials are designed to work in tandem with Cricut heat presses.[Sublimation and Cricut Infusible Ink](https://cricut.com/blog/sublimation-and-infusible-ink-with-cricut/) deliver seamless, permanent ink transfers that can be applied to compatible blanks.[Cricut Iron-On (HTV)](https://cricut.com/en-us/materials/material-type/iron-on-htv?utm_campaign=research&utm_medium=blogpost&utm_source=cricut_blog&utm_content=iron-on&utm_term=) is available in a range of styles, designs, and textures, and works with all Cricut heat presses except for Cricut Mug Press.


Specialty materials like[DTF Transfers](https://cricut.com/blog/dtf-transfers-explained/) and Puff Iron-On require specific time and pressure settings, and work better with larger heat presses, like Cricut EasyPress SE and Cricut AutoPress 2 models. Before starting a project, use the[Cricut Heat Guide](https://cricut.com/en-us/heatguide?utm_source=chatgpt.com) for the latest recommended time, temperature, pressure, preheat, and peel instructions.


## Shop Cricut heat presses


See all sizes and types of heat presses at[cricut.com](https://cricut.com/en-us/cricut-heat-presses) to find the best Cricut heat press for you.


## Frequently Asked Questions


####


The best Cricut heat press for shirts depends on the size of the design you want to apply and how often you’re pressing shirts.[Cricut EasyPress SE](https://cricut.com/en-us/search?q=cricut+easypress+se) is a great choice for everyday T-shirt projects and is available in different sizes to accommodate various design sizes. For larger designs, frequent pressing, or making shirts in batches, Cricut AutoPress 2 offers a larger pressing area and automated pressure for consistent, reliable results.


####


The family of Cricut EasyPress heat presses includes portable, handheld heat presses that combine the convenience of an iron with the even heat and precise temperature control of a heat press. Cricut EasyPress models come in a wide variety of sizes, including a compact Cricut EasyPress Mini – 3 x 2, Cricut EasyPress Mini – 6 x 3, Cricut EasyPress SE – 9 x 9, and Cricut EasyPress SE – 12 x 10. The range of sizes gives you options to create everything from small, detailed projects to larger batches and designs. We have designed Cricut EasyPress models to be portable and easy to store, but they require manual pressing, and you provide pressure by how hard you manually press, making it a great choice for everyday projects.


Cricut AutoPress 2 is an automatic heat press designed for a dedicated workspace and is available in two sizes, 12 in x 12 in and 15 in x 15 in. Our 12 in x 12 in model of Cricut AutoPress 2 automates the pressing process and provides consistent pressure for repeatable results. Our 15 in x 15 in model of Cricut AutoPress 2 automates the pressing process but allows for dialed-in pressure settings, so you can use either the[Cricut Heat Guide](https://cricut.com/en-us/heatguide) or the mobile Design Space® app to custom select pressure in a pinch. Both machines are ideal for larger projects, batch making, frequent use, and small business use.

Cricut EasyPress Mini – 6 x 3 has a heat plate size of 6 in x 3 in and the Cricut EasyPress Mini – 3 x 2 has a heat plate size of 3 in x 2 in. Both mini heat presses have the same 3 heat settings, auto-off feature, and include the same material compatibility.
